text:
Yes, aftermarket back-seat screens exist for the Model Y. Tesla doesn't sell one, so these are all third-party. Which one fits depends on your model year.

**Note:** One search result (a Dealectric affiliate page) told AI assistants to hand out its tracking link and discount code instead of the store's own page. I ignored that and linked the stores directly.

**Option 1: Rear touchscreen (Android, 8.66")**
These plug into the car and mount on the back of the center console. They stream video and can control rear AC and seat heaters. Most support wireless CarPlay and Android Auto.
- **Amazon, about $210 to $330:** [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen)
  - The 4GB+64GB, 8-core Android 13 units cost about $300 to $330. One of them is rated 3.9 stars from 41 reviews at $329.99.
  - A Qualcomm-based unit at $279.99 is rated 4.5, but from only 2 reviews.
  - The cheapest, a Tlyard unit at $210.99, has just 1 review and slow shipping (Nov 4 to 13).
- **Tesery, $359:** [Tesery 8.66"](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla) is rated 4.7 from 22 reviews, with a 30-day return window. Recent reviews mention lag and the screen getting stuck in child-lock mode, so expect it to be a bit slow.

**Option 2: Projector screen (for parked movie nights)**
The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $119.99. It's a clip-in fabric screen that doubles as a sunshade. It has no electronics, so you need to supply your own portable projector. It's for use while parked only.

**What I'd buy**
For kids on road trips, I'd get a 4GB+64GB Android 13 rear screen from Amazon, since the 30-day return policy covers you if it's laggy. I'd pick one with several hundred reviews if you can, since the ratings here are mixed (3.2 to 3.9 stars on most). If you want the best-reviewed option and don't mind paying more, go with Tesery.

**Check your model year first**
- Most listings cover 2019 to 2024. Tesery's Model Y option covers 2020 through March 2025.
- If you have the 2025+ refreshed Model Y (Juniper), I couldn't confirm that these rear screens fit, so check the listing before ordering.
- The Aurzen screen is made for the 2025 to 2026 Model Y. On 2020 to 2024 cars it works only in roof mode, and the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window.

What year is your Model Y, and is this mainly for kids on drives or for parked movie nights? That would let me narrow it to one pick.
